fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has documented disease progression per Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors 1.1 (RECIST 1.1), as assessed by investigator after receiving an anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (anti-PD-1)/programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) treatment and platinum-based chemotherapy for Stage IV disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Disease progression per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by the investigator is a subjective imaging judgment.
